subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido killed Pelek.
source_quote: Buppido had killed Pelek.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum carried Pelek's bones in the hope of finding a proper resting place.
source_quote: Grygum had carried Pelek's bones in the hope of finding a proper resting place.

subject: Glyphic Shroomlight
fact: Glyphic Shroomlight reconsidered interring Pelek's bones when Pelek's ghost materialized before him.
source_quote: When Pelek's ghost materialized before him, Glyphic quickly reconsidered, not wishing to be haunted for the rest of his days.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum interred Pelek's bones in a quiet corner of the catacombs, performing a dragon-themed ritual and planting a gold coin as a symbolic foundation.
source_quote: Grygum found a quiet corner and carefully interred Pelek's bones, performing a dragon-themed ritual and planting a gold coin as a symbolic foundation.

subject: Pelek
fact: Pelek expressed profound relief and gratitude, having feared he would be lost forever, tormenting people for eternity.
source_quote: Pelek expressed profound relief and gratitude, having feared he would be lost forever, tormenting people for eternity.

subject: Jadger
fact: Jadger explained that he was working to re-establish the Borough Wardens and was secretly training young gnomes for this purpose.
source_quote: Jadger explained that he was working to re-establish the Borough Wardens and was secretly training young gnomes for this purpose.

subject: Jadger
fact: Jadger offered the party a deal: for every ghost they helped put to rest, he would answer one question about the Underdark and its dangers.
source_quote: He offered the party a deal: for every ghost they helped put to rest, he would answer one question about the Underdark and its dangers.

subject: Jadger
fact: Jadger explained the difference between devils and demons: devils corrupt individuals through personal deals, while demons empower proxies to cause widespread carnage and destruction.
source_quote: He explained the difference between devils and demons: devils corrupt individuals through personal deals, while demons empower proxies to cause widespread carnage and destruction.

subject: Jadger
fact: Jadger advised the party to search for someone or something that was motivating the oozes, suggesting that a demon had likely granted power to an intermediate agent.
source_quote: He advised the party to search for someone or something that was motivating the oozes, suggesting that a demon had likely granted power to an intermediate agent.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir performed an impressive martial display to demonstrate a monk technique for Jadger's trainees.
source_quote: After Zalthir performed an impressive martial display, Jadger explained the difference between devils and demons...

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir activated his eldritch claw tattoo, growing tentacles from his hands that allowed him to strike from a distance.
source_quote: Zalthir activated his eldritch claw tattoo, growing tentacles from his hands that allowed him to strike from a distance...

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir replied that he was merely an aspiring ooze when Glabbagool asked if he was an ooze.
source_quote: Zalthir replied that he was merely an aspiring ooze, which seemed to satisfy the curious cube.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum channeled divine energy through his holy symbol, blasting one of the cubes with searing necrotic force.
source_quote: Grygum channeled divine energy through his holy symbol, blasting one of the cubes with searing necrotic force.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz unleashed a massive explosion of fire, dissolving one cube entirely and severely damaging the others while avoiding the merchant stalls.
source_quote: Daz carefully positioned himself and unleashed a massive explosion of fire, dissolving one cube entirely and severely damaging the others while avoiding the merchant stalls.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz unleashed another fiery explosion during the battle.
source_quote: Daz unleashed another fiery explosion.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir delivered the killing blow to the last remaining cube.
source_quote: Zalthir delivered the killing blow.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin complained that he wanted to do it.
source_quote: Thorin complained that he wanted to do it.

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool protested that mindless gelatinous cubes were giving intelligent gelatinous cubes a bad name.
source_quote: Glabbagool protested that these mindless creatures were giving intelligent gelatinous cubes a bad name.

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool advised the party to avoid being engulfed, use acid protection if they had any, and pull out anyone who got trapped as quickly as possible.
source_quote: He quickly advised the party to avoid being engulfed, to use acid protection if they had any, and to pull out anyone who got trapped as quickly as possible.

subject: Jadger's young gnome trainee
fact: Jadger is mentoring a young gnome who will soon lead the new Borough Wardens, but the gnome's identity and full capabilities are not yet revealed in this session.
source_quote: He also recommended they speak with a young gnome he was mentoring, who would soon lead the new Borough Wardens, once they had gathered more information.

subject: Pelek
fact: Pelek's spirit faded away, leaving the party with a warm, comforting feeling of having done the right thing.
source_quote: As the party said their goodbyes, Pelek's spirit faded away, leaving them with a warm, comforting feeling of having done the right thing.

subject: Jadger
fact: Jadger appeared immediately after Pelek's spirit faded.
source_quote: Almost immediately, another ghost appeared—Borough Warden Jadger...

subject: Gnomes
fact: The gnomes eyed Glabbagool with suspicion.
source_quote: As the party explored, they noticed the gnomes eyeing Glabbagool with suspicion...

subject: Sergeant
fact: A sergeant guided the party through the Trader's Grotto and explained that fungi had once grown there until a medusa's spell turned them to stone centuries ago.
source_quote: A sergeant guided them through the cavern, proudly explaining that fungi had once grown there until a medusa's spell turned them to stone centuries ago.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir rushed forward to strike one of the cubes with powerful blows before retreating to safety.
source_quote: Zalthir rushing forward to strike one of the cubes with powerful blows before retreating to safety.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin kept his distance, hurling darts at the creatures.
source_quote: Thorin kept his distance, hurling darts at the creatures.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum channeled more divine energy during the battle.
source_quote: Grygum channeled more divine energy...

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin moved closer to strike with his darts.
source_quote: Thorin moved closer to strike with his darts.
